create_config_from_pretrained: create a model configuration from a pretrained model name or local directory path
save_config_to_directory: save a model configuration object to a directory as a JSON file
convert_config_to_dict: convert a model configuration instance to a Python dictionary for serialization
update_config_from_string: update model configuration attributes from a comma-separated string of key=value pairs
get_text_config_from_model: get the text encoder or decoder configuration from a composite model config
